name: Rowing Machine
steps: Sit on the sliding seat, secure your feet and grasp the handle lightly with palms down.
Bend your knees until your shins are near vertical and lean slightly forward with straight arms.
Push with your legs, then open your hips slightly past upright and draw the handle to your lower ribs.
Extend your arms, tip forward at the hips and bend your knees to slide into the next stroke.
Continue linking the strokes at a steady pace.
tips: Follow the legs-back-arms drive and arms-back-legs recovery sequence so the handle travels in a clean horizontal path.
Avoid pulling early with your arms or rounding your lower back at the catch.
